cards.title: Back in Our Roles
cards.instruction: Return immediately to the role you usually play in this relationship, even when the present situation calls for something different.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're upset. I'll make tea and telephone whoever needs sorting out.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you just listen?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Who am I listening about?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Nobody needs fixing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll fix the temperature of the tea while you explain.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're crying, love. I'll make tea and ring your manager, like last time.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mum, I've been promoted. Could you just listen?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Will they give you enough staff?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes. Just raise your cup and say congratulations.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Congratulations. Now, who covers you when you're ill?

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 offers practical rescue and A5 returns to fixing, but neither establishes this as A's usual relationship role.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 answers B2's listening request; A5 redirects fixing toward tea after B4 excludes fixing people.

relationship.evidence: B2 wants listening and B4 protects that wish, but A1 leaves their shared history unspecified.

heightening.evidence: A5 preserves the fixing impulse through tea, though it reduces rather than substantially extends A1's intervention.

specificity.evidence: A1 supplies upset, tea and a possible telephone call; B2 gives an immediately playable emotional need.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's tea-temperature workaround earns its joke from B4's refusal of repair.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 establishes habitual maternal crisis management with 'like last time'; A3 and A5 immediately return to protective questioning despite celebration being requested.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's promotion produces A3's staffing concern; B4's requested congratulations produces A5's brief compliance followed by concern about sickness cover.

relationship.evidence: B2 identifies Mum and asks to be heard; B4 gives her a manageable celebratory role that A5 converts back into mothering.

heightening.evidence: A5 absorbs B4's explicit toast instruction and resumes oversight immediately, although sickness cover is only a modest escalation from A3's staffing question.

specificity.evidence: A1's tears, tea and previous manager intervention establish playable mistaken concern; B2 clearly reveals the actual occasion.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's 'Congratulations. Now' economically exposes the reflex, though the two employment questions in A3 and A5 are closely similar.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 changes the news from apparent distress to promotion; A3 redirects habitual protection toward the new job's staffing.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 specifies a toast; A5 delivers it before immediately resuming protective management.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A1 establishes the usual maternal fixer role; A3 and A5 preserve it when B requests listening and celebration.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 makes even explicit participation in the celebration a brief prelude to the same oversight.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: S81 makes A immediately resume an established relationship role despite a present need for different behavior.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: General compulsive helpfulness can look similar without any evidence that fixing is this relationship's familiar division of labor.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: The original A1 and A5 show fixing but omit its history; revised A1's 'like last time' and B2's 'Mum' establish the returning role.

records.recommendedEdit: The original lacked an established role. The revision introduces a mother and newly promoted child. Separate internal reread: fidelity 5, logic 5, relationship 4, heightening 4, specificity 5, brevity 4 = 92. A3 converts B2's promotion into staffing concern; B4's toast briefly succeeds before A5 resumes maternal contingency planning. Five spoken turns and under 75 words.
records.remainingConcern: The final concern varies the staffing concern more than it increases the stakes. No rewrite needed.
records.writerReservation: A5 makes a modest escalation into continuing workplace oversight; its effectiveness depends on sincere concern rather than a knowingly comic mother.
records.alternativeComparison: Alternative b uses a sibling's covert excuse-making; this version uses a mother's overt protective questions during good news.

cards.title: Back in Our Roles
cards.instruction: Return immediately to the role you usually play in this relationship, even when the present situation calls for something different.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're late again. I've prepared your usual excuse.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was going to apologise honestly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Right. I'll tidy the wording.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can do this myself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then tell me what my part is before you start.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're late for Mum's birthday again. I've told her your train broke down.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm telling her I overslept. You always cover for me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Right. I'll explain how exhausted you've been.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Just come in with me. Don't explain anything.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll look exhausted too. She'll see it runs in the family.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1's 'usual excuse' establishes habitual covering, and A3 converts honesty into another editing assignment.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 uses B2's proposed apology, but A5 asks B4 to assign a role rather than demonstrably returning to it.

relationship.evidence: B2 wants honest accountability and B4 wants independence from A's established assistance.

heightening.evidence: A5 retreats to asking for a part after B4 instead of extending A1's familiar covering behavior.

specificity.evidence: A1 supplies recurring lateness and a prepared excuse, though the apology's recipient remains unspecified.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's 'tidy the wording' neatly exposes how A absorbs B2's honesty into the old arrangement.

cardFidelity.evidence: B2 explicitly identifies A's habitual covering; A3 protects B's admission and A5 invents silent cover after explanations are prohibited.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's oversleeping becomes A3's exhaustion excuse; B4's 'Don't explain anything' directly changes A5's tactic to looking exhausted.

relationship.evidence: B2 wants to tell Mum the truth; B4 still wants A's company, giving A5 a credible opportunity to resume the protective sibling role.

heightening.evidence: A5 recruits A's own appearance as corroborating evidence after B4 closes the verbal route, increasing participation in the cover-up.

specificity.evidence: A1 supplies Mum's birthday, repeated lateness and an already-delivered train excuse, making the immediate problem clear.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's family-exhaustion inference earns its joke through B4's silence constraint, though the family explanation is slightly polished.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 offers the truthful oversleeping account; A3 immediately supplies a sympathetic explanation for it.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 permits accompanying B but forbids explanation; A5 substitutes a visible family resemblance in exhaustion.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A keeps resuming the established sibling protector role even when B explicitly chooses accountability.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 turns A's own body into supporting evidence for the excuse rather than relinquishing the role.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: S81 makes A resume the customary role in this particular relationship when the present situation calls for stepping out of it.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: Ordinary dishonesty would explain an excuse but would not explain A repeatedly reclaiming the sibling's established protective role.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: Original A1 names the usual excuse; revised B2 explicitly names habitual covering, and revised A5 finds a silent way to continue it.

records.recommendedEdit: Replaced the original A5's role-seeking with an actual return to covering. New setting: siblings entering their mother's birthday celebration. Separate internal reread: fidelity 5, logic 5, relationship 5, heightening 4, specificity 5, brevity 4 = 95. B2's oversleeping produces A3's exhaustion defense; B4's silence constraint produces A5's proposed appearance. Five spoken turns, under 75 words.
records.remainingConcern: A5 needs sincere protective intent in performance to avoid sounding like a knowing gag. No rewrite needed.
records.writerReservation: A5 describes a proposed performance within spoken dialogue; actors should preserve A's sincere belief that this will help.
records.alternativeComparison: Unlike a's mother-child reassurance, b makes the protective sibling adapt from spoken excuses to silent corroboration.

cards.title: The Other Favorite
cards.instruction: Treat every sign of attention, trust, and affection as something to compare with what another connection appears to receive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Sam's photo has a bigger frame than mine.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It was a bigger photograph.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: So you had room for more Sam.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can buy matching frames.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Only if mine doesn't look like compensation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Sam's photo has a bigger frame than mine.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It was a bigger photograph.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: So you had room for more Sam.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can buy matching frames.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Only if mine doesn't look like compensation.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 compares frame sizes; A3 interprets B2's photograph size as greater space for Sam; A5 compares the meaning of equal treatment.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 specifically reinterprets B2's bigger photograph, and A5 makes B4's matching-frame solution conditional.

relationship.evidence: B2 offers a practical explanation and B4 offers repair, changing A's complaint from inequality to compensatory equality.

heightening.evidence: A5 demands that B4's equality also appear unprompted, making reassurance harder to supply.

specificity.evidence: A1's two displayed photographs and unequal frames make the comparison immediately visible and playable.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's 'more Sam' compresses the emotional misreading, and A5's compensation condition follows directly from B4.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 measures affection through competing photo frames; A3 interprets photograph size as room for Sam, and A5 distrusts corrective equality.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's larger photograph becomes A3's 'more Sam'; B4's matching-frame offer becomes A5's concern about compensation.

relationship.evidence: B2 offers a practical explanation and B4 offers repair, but neither turn gives B much personal stake beyond soothing A.

heightening.evidence: A5 makes B4's proposed equality potentially prove original favoritism, tightening the same comparison without substantially increasing consequences.

specificity.evidence: A1's unequal frames are immediately playable, though A1 through A5 leave the relationship and display location unspecified.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's 'room for more Sam' and A5's 'compensation' concisely turn B2 and B4's practical answers into fresh comparative evidence.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 explains the physical size difference; A3 reads that exact difference as greater emotional accommodation for Sam.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 offers matching frames; A5 treats the proposed repair as evidence that A needed compensating.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A converts both display choices and remedial attention into comparison with Sam.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: The comparison moves from unequal objects to whether equal treatment can ever count as unprompted affection.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: S82 converts attention or affection into a comparison with what a competing connection appears to receive.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: General insecurity seeks reassurance without necessarily measuring one's treatment against another person's.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: A1 names Sam's larger frame, A3 reads its size as emotional allocation, and A5 keeps comparing even after B4 offers equality.

records.recommendedEdit: Retained unchanged after a second internal reread with the same ratings and total of 94. B4's helpful matching-frame offer causes A5 to demand equality without the stigma of compensation. All spoken-turn, causal and length gates pass.
records.remainingConcern: B's relationship to A remains open, and B's main function is reassurance. No rewrite needed.
records.writerReservation: The exact family or romantic relationship remains open, and A5's concern about appearances benefits from a sincere rather than arch delivery.
records.alternativeComparison: Alternative b makes relative favor publicly legible at a sister's wedding; a questions whether private material equality can be authentic.

cards.title: The Other Favorite
cards.instruction: Treat every sign of attention, trust, and affection as something to compare with what another connection appears to receive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Their invitation has a ribbon. Mine has a staple.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I ran out of ribbon.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: At exactly my place in the affection queue.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You were the first invitation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then why did you start with stationery instead of love?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Clare's wedding invitation has a ribbon. Mine has a staple.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're my sister. I gave you the first one, before the ribbon arrived.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: So Clare got the version you were proud of.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Take my ribbon. I'm the bride.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Will Clare know? Otherwise she'll still think you like her more.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 compares ribbon with staple and A3 makes it an affection queue, but A5 weakens the explicit comparison with another connection.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 uses B2's shortage, but B4's 'first invitation' leaves the timing of that shortage unresolved.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 supply explanations, but B4 mostly introduces a reversal for A5 to answer.

heightening.evidence: A5 rejects priority as reassurance, though 'stationery instead of love' is less specific than A3's queue.

specificity.evidence: A1's ribbon and staple make the unequal invitations concrete; B4 complicates their production history.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's affection queue is compact and grounded in B2, while A5 becomes a broader aphoristic complaint.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 compares invitation treatment with Clare's; A3 discounts sibling priority, and A5 requires Clare to recognize the apparent preference.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's early unfinished invitation becomes A3's inferior version; B4's personal ribbon offer causes A5 to ask whether Clare will know.

relationship.evidence: B2 explains the sister's privileged early access; B4 offers the bride's own ribbon, giving B a meaningful concession that A still evaluates competitively.

heightening.evidence: A5 turns B4's sacrifice into a demand for the rival's awareness, expanding the contest from treatment to public recognition.

specificity.evidence: A1's ribbon versus staple and B2's sister relationship clearly establish wedding preparations and the disputed evidence.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's 'version you were proud of' sharply reinterprets B2; A5's explanation of Clare's belief is effective but slightly explicit.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 explains that A received the first invitation before ribbon arrived; A3 reclassifies that priority as receiving the inferior draft.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 offers the bride's ribbon; A5 asks for the concession to register with Clare as evidence of affection.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A evaluates early access and a personal sacrifice solely through what Clare appears to receive.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 requires comparative recognition from the third party, not merely possession of an improved invitation.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: S82 makes A assess each sign of affection by comparing it with what another connection receives.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: A complaint about shoddy presentation could concern an invitation's quality without treating that quality as a ranking of relationships.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: Original A3 explicitly calls the distribution an affection queue; revised A3 and A5 compare the bride's pride and apparent liking for Clare.

records.recommendedEdit: Clarified the ribbon chronology and restored a concrete comparative A5. New setting: a bride and her sister inspecting invitations. Separate internal reread: fidelity 5, logic 5, relationship 4, heightening 4, specificity 5, brevity 4 = 92. B2's early delivery becomes A3's inferior draft; B4's personal ribbon offer becomes A5's demand for visible comparative status. Five spoken turns, under 75 words.
records.remainingConcern: The bride's ribbon is somewhat unspecified, but the personal concession is clear. No rewrite needed.
records.writerReservation: A5 moves into public comparison rather than private reassurance; it should remain a vulnerable request rather than calculated social domination.
records.alternativeComparison: This version adds sisterly entitlement and the rival's knowledge; a stays with private doubts about compensatory equality.

cards.title: Old Reflex
cards.instruction: Turn to this person first whenever uncertainty appears, as an old reflex. Notice the habit only after you have already involved them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Which key opens my new flat? Sorry, you haven't been there.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You chose it without me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Right. Which pocket would I have put the key in?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your left, usually.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: There it is. We still work on the smaller decisions.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Which key opens my new flat? Sorry, you haven't been there.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You chose it without me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Right. Which pocket would I have put the key in?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your left, usually. Put a hook by the door so you won't need to ring me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: There it is. How high should the hook go? You've never seen the door. I'll send you a photo.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 asks about the key before remembering B has not visited; A3 reflexively redirects another uncertainty to the same person.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's exclusion from the flat choice prompts A3's smaller question; B4's left-pocket answer produces A5's discovery.

relationship.evidence: B2 registers hurt over exclusion, yet B4 still supplies intimate practical knowledge.

heightening.evidence: A5 turns successful help into a claim about their remaining partnership, but adds little new uncertainty or action.

specificity.evidence: A1's new flat and B4's habitual pocket make changed circumstances and retained familiarity concrete.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's retreat from choosing a flat to finding a key is economical; A5 lightly explains its emotional implication.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 asks before remembering B has never visited; A5 again consults B before noticing that same limitation.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 rules out knowledge of the flat, so A3 seeks knowledge of personal habits; B4's hook suggestion generates A5's installation question.

relationship.evidence: B2 marks lost involvement in major decisions; B4 offers familiar practical help while trying to reduce future calls.

heightening.evidence: B4 proposes independence through a hook; A5 turns installing that very solution into another consultation and a promised photo.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes a new flat and missing key knowledge; B4's left pocket and door hook give actors concrete tasks.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's 'I'll send you a photo' neatly extends the dependence, though its three successive clauses slightly underline the mechanism.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 identifies a decision made without B; A3 redirects to the pocket habit B could still know.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 supplies both the key location and the hook solution; A5 confirms the discovery and immediately requests hook advice.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A1 and A5 both involve B before acknowledging why that consultation is habitual rather than necessary.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 recruits B into implementing B4's proposed way to stop needing B.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: S83 makes uncertainty trigger consultation of this person before A notices that the old habit has operated.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: S89 seeks evidence of continuing specialness deliberately, whereas S83 begins with an unconsidered practical appeal.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: A1 asks before remembering B lacks access; A5 asks about hook height before recognizing the same knowledge gap and involving B further through a photograph.

records.recommendedEdit: Revised the rejected reflective ending while preserving the new-flat and pocket seed. Separate internal reread: card fidelity 5, because A1 and A5 recognize consultation only after asking; response logic 5, because B2's exclusion prompts A3's familiar pocket question and B4's hook prompts A5's installation question; relationship 4, because B2 expresses hurt and B4 offers a way to stop the calls; heightening 4, because A5 extends successful key-finding into photographic consultation about the new home; specificity 5, because A1's flat and B4's hook establish playable practical choices; brevity and wit 4, because A5 makes the proposed cure generate another call without explanatory commentary. Total 92. Five spoken ABABA turns, 73 words; all hard gates pass on internal reread.
records.remainingConcern: The relationship change remains implicit, and A5 slightly explains its own reflex. No rewrite needed.
records.writerReservation: A5's photograph offer becomes deliberate after the reflex is noticed; the initial height question must carry the automatic appeal. The shared relationship remains implied by B2's hurt and B4's familiar knowledge.
records.alternativeComparison: Unlike S83-single-b's urgent clothing delivery and social reassurance, this alternative converts practical independence into renewed domestic consultation.

cards.title: Almost Forgiven
cards.instruction: Behave as though the past is nearly resolved, but let each small disappointment reopen one precise part of the hurt.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've forgiven the missed birthday. Pass the calendar.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then why is that date circled?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For administrative closure.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You've circled next year's too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Forgiveness benefits from advance notice.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm nearly over you missing my birthday. Shall we book dinner?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Thursday, unless work needs me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's what you said before I ate both birthday puddings.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Friday, then. I'll put a reminder in my phone.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank you. Make it say my name. Last year's just said 'dinner'.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 already maintains a birthday grievance; B2 and B4 expose calendar markings rather than provide small new disappointments that reopen hurt.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 explains B2's circle and A5 accounts for B4's next-year discovery.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 investigate the alleged forgiveness, but have little opportunity to disappoint or repair in the present.

heightening.evidence: B4 expands the calendar surveillance into next year, and A5 endorses it without reopening a newly specified wound.

specificity.evidence: A1's missed birthday and B4's next-year circle are concrete and easy to stage through dialogue.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's administrative closure and A5's advance notice sustain a concise bureaucratic treatment of forgiveness.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 offers near-forgiveness; A3 reopens the abandoned birthday through B2's work caveat, and A5 reopens the impersonal reminder through B4's repair.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's conditional availability recalls A3's two puddings; B4's phone reminder produces A5's precise request for a named entry.

relationship.evidence: B2 has a work constraint and B4 changes the date and offers a reminder; B is a repair-seeking participant, though the relationship is unnamed.

heightening.evidence: A5 reveals that B4's helpful reminder touches a more personal hurt: being recorded merely as 'dinner'.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes rescheduling after a missed birthday; A3's two puddings and A5's exact calendar wording make the grievance tangible.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's birthday puddings compress the abandonment into an image; A5's quoted calendar entry supplies an earned, slightly tidy final detail.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: The work escape clause in B2 repeats the circumstances of the missed birthday recalled in A3.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 proposes a phone reminder; A5 reveals the previous reminder's impersonal wording and requests a correction.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A keeps accepting repair while each small feature of it reopens one specific surviving hurt.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 moves from missed attendance to feeling personally unrecognized, using the offered solution itself.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: S84 lets a small present disappointment reopen one precise piece of hurt while A is behaving as though reconciliation is nearly complete.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: Holding a grudge continuously lacks the card's movement from apparent recovery back into a specific wound.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: Original B2 and B4 merely uncover monitoring; revised B2's work caveat recalls the abandoned puddings, and B4's reminder recalls an impersonal entry.

records.recommendedEdit: The original illustrated surveillance of an old grievance. The revision keeps birthday hurt but introduces a reconciliation dinner. Separate internal reread: fidelity 5, logic 5, relationship 4, heightening 4, specificity 5, brevity 4 = 92. B2's conditional booking causes A3's exact memory; B4's helpful reminder causes A5 to expose another precise surviving hurt. Five spoken turns, under 75 words.
records.remainingConcern: The opening states near-forgiveness directly, and the escalation is emotional specificity rather than larger action. No rewrite needed.
records.writerReservation: A5's disappointment is in the reminder's resemblance to the previous failure, not a fresh broken promise; the grateful opening helps preserve near-forgiveness.
records.alternativeComparison: Alternative b strips away a failed apology to expose forgotten family significance; a keeps practical reconciliation alive through revised dinner plans.

cards.instruction: Behave as though the past is nearly resolved, but let each small disappointment reopen one precise part of the hurt.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We're fine about the broken vase. Don't make that particular joke.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The vase joke?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The one where my disappointment is the amusing bit.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I thought we'd moved on.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We had. You brought the vase with us.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put your flowers here. I'm nearly over the vase, honestly.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: In a mug? Harder for me to improve the decor.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You said that while I picked up Mum's signature. Still, flowers are a lovely start.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Sorry. I forgot she'd painted it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Never mind. Let's find water. You did choose the blue with her, though. I kept that piece.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 claims resolution and A3 specifies hurt at being mocked, but B2 only identifies a joke that the dialogue never actually supplies.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 clarifies B2's question, and A5 answers B4's claim that they had moved on.

relationship.evidence: B4 wants the matter closed, but B2's clarification gives limited evidence of the disappointing behavior A describes.

heightening.evidence: A5 restates renewed grievance through a vase metaphor rather than revealing a further precise part of the hurt.

specificity.evidence: A1 supplies a broken vase but refers to 'that particular joke' without letting actors hear its content.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's 'brought the vase with us' follows B4's moving-on language economically.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 claims near forgiveness; B2's decor remark reopens Mum's signature in A3, and B4's forgetting reopens the shared colour choice in A5.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 explicitly identifies B2's repeated phrase; A5 answers B4's forgotten authorship with evidence that B helped choose the blue.

relationship.evidence: B2 attempts levity while bringing flowers; B4 apologizes, but its admission gives A5 another specific reason to feel hurt.

heightening.evidence: A5 deepens A3's damaged-object grievance into B's forgotten participation with Mum, then reveals the retained fragment.

specificity.evidence: A1's flowers and replacement mug establish reconciliation; A3's painted signature and A5's blue fragment make the loss concrete.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's 'Still, flowers are a lovely start' and A5's 'Never mind' keep forgiveness active while each precise recollection undermines it.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 repeats the decor joke previously made during the breakage; A3 identifies that precise verbal trigger.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 admits forgetting Mum painted the vase; A5 recalls B choosing its blue with her, making that forgetting personally consequential.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A1's near-resolution survives through A3's appreciation and A5's water-fetching proposal, even as new disappointments reopen exact details.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 moves from the lost signature to shared history and a saved shard, increasing emotional specificity without abandoning attempted reconciliation.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: S84 makes attempted reconciliation vulnerable to small disappointments that reopen exact details of a past injury.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: A sustained grievance can recount successive injuries without showing A repeatedly trying to treat the matter as nearly resolved.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: A3 returns from the remembered insult to welcoming the flowers; A5 accepts the apology and proposes water before B4's forgetting brings back the jointly chosen blue.

records.recommendedEdit: Corrected the rejected candidate's sustained grievance by restoring practical acceptance in A3 and A5. The supplied illustrative flowers-and-painted-vase setting remains. Separate internal reread: fidelity 5, because A1 welcomes repair, A3 resumes it after the joke, and A5 tries again before recalling another precise hurt; logic 5, because B2 repeats the decor insult recalled in A3 and B4's forgetting prompts A5's shared color choice; relationship 4, because B brings flowers and apologizes while A keeps making room for the gift; heightening 4, because A5 reveals the saved fragment and B's connection to its making; specificity 5, because A1's flowers, A3's signature and A5's blue shard make the history playable; brevity and wit 3, because A5's water request sustains action but the ending is chiefly poignant. Total 90. Five spoken ABABA turns and under 75 words; all hard gates pass on internal reread.

records.alternativeComparison: The preserved birthday alternative concerns future reliability and reminders; this scene uses a tangible peace offering, an inherited object and forgotten shared history.

cards.title: Easy to Love
cards.instruction: Interpret another person’s ease with affection as both admirable and unfair, then compete to seem equally worth choosing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Everyone hugs you so easily. I've brought your favourite biscuits.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You didn't have to.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Neither did they hug you, apparently. It just happens.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Come sit with us.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Gladly. I rehearsed a very spontaneous smile.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You arrive at family lunch empty-handed and everyone hugs you. It's lovely. I've baked three cakes.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They'd hug you without cake. Come sit beside me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you introduce me before mentioning the cakes? Give me a fair start.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're my brother. They know you. Leave the cakes here.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: All three? Fine. Save me whichever seat gets hugged first.

relationship.evidence: B4 offers inclusion, but B2 and B4 reveal little about which relationship or competition matters to A.

heightening.evidence: A5's rehearsed spontaneity extends performance after B4, though it leaves the competitive aim diffuse.

specificity.evidence: A1 supplies favorite biscuits and observed hugs; B4 locates an inviting group.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's rehearsed spontaneous smile is concise and follows B4's invitation, despite being somewhat self-aware.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 admires B's effortless hugs while contrasting three cakes; A3 asks for a 'fair start' and A5 competes for the seat most likely to receive affection.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's invitation and cake-free reassurance cause A3's proposed fresh introduction; B4's cake prohibition redirects A5 toward seating, though introducing a known sibling is deliberately strained.

relationship.evidence: B2 wants A beside them and B4 reminds A of existing family membership; these inclusive offers genuinely change A's competitive tactic.

heightening.evidence: After B4 removes the cakes, A5 treats seating itself as a competitive advantage, extending the same need into a smaller social detail.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes family lunch, empty-handed arrival and three cakes; B4 identifies A as B's brother.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's seat 'gets hugged first' earns its oddness from A1's hug accounting, while A3's introduction request slightly strains natural speech.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 says affection does not depend on cake and invites A in; A3 tries to arrange an encounter where the cakes cannot influence the result.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 removes the introduction premise and tells A to leave the cakes; A5 accepts but seeks a seating advantage instead.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A admires B's easy welcome while continually engineering an equally favorable reception.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: Even relinquishing the conspicuous effort of three cakes becomes an attempt to optimize access to hugs.

Separate internal reread: fidelity 5, logic 5, relationship 4, heightening 4, specificity 5, brevity 4 = 92. B2's claim that cake is unnecessary causes A3's attempted fresh introduction; B4 removes the cakes, so A5 seeks the best opportunity for affection directly. Five spoken turns, under 75 words.

cards.title: Easy to Love
cards.instruction: Interpret another person’s ease with affection as both admirable and unfair, then compete to seem equally worth choosing.

beats.text: Hello. Lovely people. Would you choose to live with that?

beats.speaker: A

cards.title: Who We Used to Be
cards.instruction: Perform the version of yourself that belonged to this relationship before it changed, and treat old chemistry as still recoverable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I wore the scarf from our first photograph.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It doesn't fit your coat anymore.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It fits the person you met.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You don't have to be that person.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Just until dessert. He knew how to make you laugh.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I wore the scarf from our first photograph.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It doesn't fit your coat anymore.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It fits the person you met.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You don't have to be that person.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Just until dessert. He knew how to make you laugh.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 says the scarf fits the person B met, and A5 keeps that former self available because he could make B laugh.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 answers B2's fit objection with emotional fit; A5 bargains for time after B4 releases A from the old identity.

relationship.evidence: B4 offers acceptance of A's changed self, creating a caring obstacle to A's reenactment.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's fit reversal and A5's dessert deadline express the same vulnerable character logic without padding.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's physical mismatch becomes A3's emotional fit; B4's permission to abandon the old self causes A5 to bargain for time until dessert.

specificity.evidence: A1's first-photograph scarf provides a playable object; A5 locates the encounter at a meal, but A1 alone leaves the occasion open.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's shift from coat fit to personal identity is concise; A5's dessert bargain is earned but more poignant than sharply comic.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 challenges the scarf's fit with the current coat; A3 explains its fit with A's former identity.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 says the former identity is unnecessary; A5 bargains to retain it temporarily because it once delighted B.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: The scarf is a means of performing an earlier self to recover shared chemistry, not nostalgia alone.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 converts the costume into a sustained personal performance with the concrete aim of making B laugh again.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: S86 makes A revive a former relational self and trust that performing it can recover the connection's old chemistry.

mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: A3 names the old person rather than the scarf's appearance, and A5 identifies making B laugh as the reason to keep performing him.

records.alternativeComparison: Unlike a's corrective memory contest, b lets B offer acceptance and has A sincerely bargain to continue the old performance.

cards.title: One Step from Distance
cards.instruction: Treat pauses, divided attention, and small boundaries as signs that the connection may be slipping away.

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: B

cards.title: Remember What I Meant
cards.instruction: Create openings for shared memories that prove your past presence mattered and still deserves acknowledgment.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've kept the little boat I made you. Remember that afternoon?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We were by the lake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And who stayed in the rain finding the right twig?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You did.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. The boat's getting credit, but I like a mention too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're putting my little boat in the wedding slideshow? Remember making it by the lake?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm cutting that slide. Nobody will know what it is.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You could mention who stood in the rain finding its mast.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've only got room for a short caption.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then 'Alex stayed until I stopped crying.' They don't need the boat-building details.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 develops B2's lake memory into the twig search; A5 responds to B4's acknowledgment but asks for credit already partly given.

heightening.evidence: A5 makes the acknowledgment wish explicit, but B4 has introduced no new pressure or choice for that wish to develop.

specificity.evidence: A1's handmade boat and A3's rainy twig search make the shared memory concrete.

specificity.evidence: A1 supplies a wedding slideshow and handmade lake boat; A3's rainy mast search and A5's caption create concrete playable stakes.

beats.text: I remember the person in it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell me that bit. The sleeve's heard enough.
